definitions.explanation: The activity of growing crops, especially through tilling the soil. Often used in historical, anthropological, or formal contexts rather than for modern industrial farming.

examples.japanese: {農耕|のうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
{農耕|のうこう}⟦{民族|みんぞく}→民族：13229_minzoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{定住|ていじゅう}→定住：12524_teijuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Agricultural peoples settle on the land.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{弥生時代|やよいじだい}→弥生時代：20426_yayoijidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{本格的|ほんかくてき}→本格的：05681_honkakuteki⟧な{農耕|のうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}まった→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧。
examples.english: Full-scale agriculture spread in Japan during the Yayoi period.

notes:
Compound of {農|のう} (agriculture) + {耕|こう} (to till). Often appears in formal, historical, or compound contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {農耕|のうこう}⟦{民族|みんぞく}→民族：13229_minzoku⟧: agricultural people
- {農耕|のうこう}⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧: agrarian culture
- {農耕|のうこう}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧: agricultural society
- {農耕|のうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従事|じゅうじ}→従事：12562_juuji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to engage in farming

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧: agriculture (industry) — the more common modern term, includes livestock
- ⟦{耕作|こうさく}→耕作：06617_kousaku⟧: cultivation — narrower, focuses on working the field
- ⟦{農作業|のうさぎょう}→農作業：14511_nousagyou⟧: farm work — the daily tasks themselves
